kind: recording-calibrated effective stereo transfer; not recovered PSS-780 schematic
method: Given observed mid, predict side using one globally periodic delay, fixed gain and fixed mid leakage. Equal-RMS weighting per training preset. No per-window phase, gain, or timing fit. Fit on 100–4000 Hz bandpassed 48 kHz signals. Delay is an effective transfer delay, not a direct BBD delay measurement.
time_origin: Seconds from beginning of decoded reference audio. The phase is a capture coordinate; no claim of hardware reset phase.
limitations: Stereo video is lossy and capture processing is not known.
Observed mid is not proven to be the raw unfiltered mono chip signal.
Delay and mid leakage describe an effective transfer, not identified physical parts.
Measured phase is specific to this capture; synthesizer demos may choose a new phase.
Baseline comparison below uses old quasi-static delay/gain approximation, not a complete BBD re-render.
